objective: Connect the DR24 Explorer to the bounded multi-OID API and expose raw records, separate QC diagnostics, provenance and JSON export in a deterministic browser workflow.

previous_knowledge_consumed.detail: POST /v1/dr24/lightcurves accepts 1–10 unique positive OIDs and returns separate raw records.
ObservationService adds separate diagnostic QC assessments without mutating raw epochs.
Existing single-OID Explorer and pinned HATS browser smoke evidence informed the UI implementation.

expected_improvement: Load 1–10 OIDs in one UI request
Render separate records without cross-OID grouping
Show separate raw-preserving QC and acquisition provenance
Export the complete batch response as JSON
Reject duplicate and over-limit input before network access

ui_batch_support.before: The DR24 Explorer accepted one OID per lookup.
ui_batch_support.after: The Explorer sends a bounded batch POST and renders one panel per returned OID.

export_integrity.after: Batch export retains all raw records, QC assessments and provenance.

scientific_validity.reason: The browser contract uses a deterministic fake backend. It does not establish live DR24 source validity.

measurement.trade_off: The batch view reduces manual lookup effort but displays each OID separately; it does not infer physical-source identity.

evidence: A deterministic Playwright browser integration test and focused GitHub Actions workflow were added.
The browser workflow uses a fake DR24 backend and tests input validation, rendering, provenance, raw export and separate QC.
CI for the current head is pending.

root_causes: The first Explorer supported only one OID per request and used a single-object GET route.
The bounded batch API and QC service response now exist in stacked PRs.
unresolved: The complete UI path has not yet passed the new browser test.
No live source-backed multi-OID API/browser parity has been run.

findings: UI batch size is capped at 10 and duplicate IDs are rejected client-side and server-side.
Raw OID records and QC assessments remain separate.
The UI does not perform inference, grouping, normalization or filtering.

open_blockers: Run the new deterministic Playwright workflow and fix failures.
Run a bounded live HATS batch request against pinned independent OID references.
Keep the batch Explorer experimental until source-backed evidence and scientific identity gates pass.

knowledge_carried_forward: The UI renders one panel per OID and exports the whole response.
QC remains diagnostic only; no epoch is removed or modified.
